behavior: `Menu.Input` names in `aria-activedescendant` the id that the highlighted item has now. It follows each change of the `id` of that item, from the `id` prop or from the `#render` slot of the item. Base UI reads the `id` of the highlighted item when `Menu.Input` renders. After a change of the `id`, its input thus names the old id until it renders again. No element has the old id then, or another item has it.
